newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chechnya's Maskhadov claims presidential victory.
newsitem.headline: Chechnya's Maskhadov claims presidential victory.

text.p: Chechen guerrilla leader Aslan Maskhadov claimed victory in the rebel region's presidential elections on Tuesday and said his first task was to establish order and stamp out "banditry".

But Maskhadov, 45, speaking at his headquarters in the Chechen town of Pervomaiskoye, alluded to lingering differences with his guerrilla rivals, singling out hardliner Shamil Basayev for criticism. "To Shamil I have long said: 'why do you lie to people on television?' But his desire to win went beyond the bounds of decency."
